questions_and_answers.question_text: उन्हें फ्रांस जाना था लेकिन वे जा नहीं सके ।

answers.answer_text: They were supposed to go to France but they couldn't go.

answers.answer_text: Today we were supposed to talk to them but couldn't do it.

questions_and_answers.question_text: उन प्रदेशों में चुनाव होने थे पर किसी वजह से हो न सके ।

answers.answer_text: Our girls were supposed to arrive here yesterday but it's not known why they didn't arrive.

questions_and_answers.question_text: शुक्रवार को स्कूल बंद होना था पर न मालूम क्यों नहीं हुआ ।

questions_and_answers.question_text: परसों उन्हें शिकागो जाना था पर न मालूम क्यों नहीं गईं ।

answers.answer_text: They were supposed to go to Chicago the day before yesterday but it's not known why they didn't go.

questions_and_answers.question_text: कल बच्चों की छुट्टी होनी थी लेकिन न मालूम क्यों नहीं हुई ।
